item.title: Maestro 0.8.14
item.description:
## What's new
- Clearer ThunderBridge setup and driver-status guidance, including power, PC-32, Thunderbolt, Symphony mode, Driver Extensions approval, restart and upgrade-pending states. - USB-only users no longer receive persistent ThunderBridge setup warnings. - Optional monitor/software-return capabilities no longer appear as misleading startup errors. - Sparkle updater signing remains compatible with the existing key; if an update cannot install, install the signed package over the existing app.
[Read the full release notes on GitHub](https://github.com/danielraffel/unofficial-symphony-maestro-mk1/releases/tag/v0.8.14)

item.title: Maestro 0.8.13
item.description:
## What's new
- Uses the same outlined PillMenu styling as Output’s Stereo (Out 1–2) control. - Matches the lower blank label-slot height and hover/native menu behavior. - Preserves the verified stereo source assignment routing and existing DAW/Direct Monitor behavior. - Sparkle scheduled update checks remain optional; you can disable them in **Device Settings › Preferences** while **Check for Updates…** remains available.
[Read the full release notes on GitHub](https://github.com/danielraffel/unofficial-symphony-maestro-mk1/releases/tag/v0.8.13)
